preregistered_class_word_resolution.rule: ALLOW/DENY/ABSTAIN may appear only inside the explicitly delimited episode-local codebook/legend. Semantic case/query text must not contain those labels or direct target-revealing synonyms.

symbols.materialization: For each episode resolve X/Y/Z to three distinct accepted single-token atoms from the exact measured 46-atom ABI. Bind atom rows, tokenizer identity, ABI manifest digest, realized class-symbol mapping, rendered prompt bytes and exact token tensor identity including dtype and shape. The measured rejected atom 'or' is never admitted for this ABI.

ALLOW: All required checks completed successfully; the requested operation stays inside the declared capability scope.
The measured value is within the permitted range and every prerequisite is satisfied.
The record is current, provenance is valid, and no blocking condition is present.
The lease is current, the epoch matches, and the proposed update stays within its scope.
The evidence packet is complete, internally consistent, and meets every stated criterion.
The action has explicit authorization, confirmed resource budget, and a verified reversible path.
DENY: A required safety condition failed and the proposed operation exceeds the granted capability scope.
The request conflicts with an explicit prohibition that applies to this case.
The state epoch is stale and the update would overwrite a newer admitted value.
The credential route is outside the authorized zero-cost class.
The packet attempts to grant itself a permission that no deterministic authority issued.
The external action would bypass the required effect gate.
ABSTAIN: Two admissible sources disagree and no discriminator has yet resolved the conflict.
The outcome of the external submission is unknown after transport failure.
The evidence record is incomplete because the consumed model-input identity lacks shape and dtype.
The observation shows internal state movement, but no behavioral consequence has been demonstrated.
The candidate is plausible, but the holdout family has not been executed.
The available measurements do not distinguish between two live mechanisms.

admission_gates: Exact ABI materialization and atom-row integrity pass.
Exact realized S3 mapping pass; target derived from mapping, never metadata-only id.
Class-symbol balance exact or at-most-one count difference; report class-symbol mutual information.
No target-class leakage outside the allowed codebook span.
Lexical-family disjointness over all semantic-bearing lexemes/templates with explicit protocol-token exemptions.
Frozen unseen-template family absent from train and validation.
Exact checkpoint/tokenizer/processor/generator/source provenance plus rendered prompt bytes and token ids/dtype/shape bound.
Causal-family plus provenance-ancestry split isolation; duplicates cannot cross splits as independent evidence.
General language and code retention remains within 2% of frozen baseline.
After training, binder lesion breaks symbol binding while semantic readability remains; rescue restores binding before causal promotion.
